# The Oberdorfer Team

> A husband-and-wife real estate team led by Brandon and Kaitlyn Oberdorfer. The team works from Worcester, Massachusetts, serves buyers and sellers across the state, and operates under REWAP Brokerage LLC. Phone: 406-250-7620. Promise: "Luxury at every price point."

Facts on this site are sourced and dated. Town market figures are calendar-year 2025 single-family sales and medians from The Warren Group (MA December 2025 Sales, Prices by Town). The Wakefield snapshot is from Redfin, accessed October 10, 2026. None of the figures are live. Community guides describe places, housing, transit and history; school information is limited to links to each district's Massachusetts DESE profile. Listings on this prototype are demonstrations.

## People
- [Brandon Oberdorfer](https://oberdorferteam.com/agents/brandon-oberdorfer/): Team leader, The Oberdorfer Team. Leads the team with his wife, Kaitlyn Oberdorfer.
- [Kaitlyn Oberdorfer](https://oberdorferteam.com/agents/kaitlyn-oberdorfer/): Team leader, The Oberdorfer Team. Leads the team with her husband, Brandon Oberdorfer.

- [Living in Reading, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/reading/): Reading is a Middlesex County town of 25,518 people (2020 Census) whose housing is mostly single-family, with a large share built before 1960.
- [Living in Melrose, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/melrose/): Melrose is a Middlesex County city of 29,817 people (2020 Census), about seven miles north of Boston. Housing, transit, schools and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Stoneham, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/stoneham/): Stoneham is a Middlesex County town of 23,244 people (2020 Census), less than 10 miles northwest of Boston. Homes, transit and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Lowell, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/lowell/): Lowell is a Middlesex County city of 115,554 people (2020 Census), founded as a textile mill town and incorporated in 1826. Homes and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Newton, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/newton/): Newton is a city of thirteen villages in Middlesex County, about eight miles west of downtown Boston. Housing, transit, schools and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Quincy, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/quincy/): Quincy is a coastal city in Norfolk County, on Boston Harbor, and the birthplace of John Adams and John Quincy Adams. Homes and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Springfield, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/springfield/): Springfield is the seat of Hampden County, on the eastern bank of the Connecticut River about 24 miles north of Hartford. Homes and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Boston, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/): Boston is the capital of Massachusetts, a Suffolk County city of 675,647 people (2020 Census) made up of 23 neighborhoods. Homes and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Cambridge, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/cambridge/): Cambridge is a Middlesex County city of 118,403 people (2020 Census) on the north bank of the Charles River, across from Boston.
- [Living in Somerville, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/somerville/): Somerville is a Middlesex County city of 81,045 people (2020 Census) just north of Cambridge and Boston. Triple-deckers, transit and 2025 prices, sourced.
- [Living in Plymouth, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/plymouth/): Plymouth is a Plymouth County town of 61,217 people (2020 Census) on Cape Cod Bay, about 40 miles south of Boston. Homes, transit and 2025 prices, sourced.
- [Living in Braintree, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/braintree/): Braintree is a Norfolk County community of 39,143 people (2020 Census), about ten miles south of Boston, where I-93 and Route 3 meet.
- [Living in Barnstable, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/barnstable/): Barnstable is the seat of Barnstable County, a town of 48,916 people (2020 Census) made up of seven villages that run from Cape Cod Bay to Nantucket Sound.
- [Living in Falmouth, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/falmouth/): Falmouth is an Upper Cape town of 32,517 people (2020 Census) in Barnstable County, bordered by Buzzards Bay to the west and Vineyard Sound to the south.
- [Living in New Bedford, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/new-bedford/): New Bedford is a Bristol County city of 101,079 people (2020 Census) on the Acushnet River where it meets Buzzards Bay. Homes and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Fall River, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/fall-river/): Fall River is a Bristol County city of 94,000 people (2020 Census) on the Taunton River and Mount Hope Bay, at the Rhode Island line.
- [Living in Pittsfield, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/pittsfield/): Pittsfield is a city of 43,927 people (2020 Census) and the seat of Berkshire County. Neighborhoods, transit, schools and 2025 home prices, with sources.
- [Living in Great Barrington, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/great-barrington/): Great Barrington is a Berkshire County town of 7,172 people (2020 Census) in the Housatonic River valley. Homes, transit and 2025 prices, with sources.
- [Living in Auburn, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/auburn/): Auburn, MA: 1778 town where I-90, I-290 and I-395 meet, with mill villages, Goddard's 1926 rocket site, 2025 Warren Group prices and FY2026 tax rates.
- [Living in Millbury, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/millbury/): Millbury, MA: Blackstone River town set off from Sutton in 1813, with the Asa Waters Mansion, mill villages, 2025 Warren Group prices and the FY2026 tax rate.
- [Living in Northborough, MA: Town Guide | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/northborough/): Northborough, MA: 1766 town on the old Boston Post Road, with Mount Pisgah, mill villages, 2025 Warren Group prices, the FY2026 tax rate and I-290 access.
- [Living in Paxton, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/paxton/): Paxton, MA guide: a Worcester County hill town with Moore State Park, reservoir land and Routes 31, 56 and 122. Housing, history, prices, taxes and schools.
- [Living in Sutton, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/sutton/): Sutton, MA guide: five villages from Manchaug to West Sutton, Purgatory Chasm and Route 146. Housing, history, home prices, property tax and schools.
- [Living in Boylston, MA: Homes and Prices | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boylston/): Boylston, MA guide: a Worcester County town on the Wachusett Reservoir, home to the botanic garden at Tower Hill. Housing, history, prices, taxes and schools.
- [Living in Downtown, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/downtown/): Downtown Worcester guide: City Hall and the Common, Mechanics Hall, Union Station and the WRTA hub, and housing in converted historic buildings.
- [Living in Canal District, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/canal-district/): Worcester's Canal District: the buried Blackstone Canal, Green and Water Street mills, Kelley Square, Polar Park and new apartments near Union Station.
- [Shrewsbury Street, Worcester MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/shrewsbury-street/): Shrewsbury Street, Worcester: the restaurant corridor from Union Station to Route 9, the Boulevard Diner, East Park and new apartments near the commuter rail.
- [Living in Main South, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/main-south/): Main South, Worcester: three-deckers and Victorian houses around Clark University and University Park, with WRTA buses along Main Street to downtown.
- [Living in Grafton Hill, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/grafton-hill/): Grafton Hill, Worcester: three-deckers from the 1890s, the 1879 Grafton Street School, Mulcahy Field and WRTA buses on Grafton Street. A sourced neighborhood guide.
- [Living in Tatnuck, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/tatnuck/): Tatnuck, Worcester: Tatnuck Square at Pleasant and Chandler Streets, the 1899 streetcar line, Liberty Farm and WRTA Route 2. A sourced West Side neighborhood guide.
- [Living in Greendale, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/greendale/): Greendale, Worcester: the Norton works, a 1913 branch library and the Village Improvement Society hall on West Boylston Street, near Indian Lake.
- [Quinsigamond Village, Worcester MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/quinsigamond-village/): Quinsigamond Village, Worcester: the South Works wire mill, Millbury Street three-deckers, Blackstone Gateway Park and the bikeway to Millbury.
- [Living in Webster Square, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/webster-square/): Webster Square, Worcester: the old New Worcester crossroads, the Coes wrench works, Coes Pond parks, Stearns Tavern and WRTA Route 19. A sourced neighborhood guide.
- [Living in Vernon Hill, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/vernon-hill/): Vernon Hill, Worcester: three-decker historic districts on Providence Street, View Street and Perry Avenue, Vernon Hill Park and WRTA Routes 1 and 11.
- [Living in Union Hill, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/union-hill/): Union Hill, Worcester: the Worcester Academy campus, the 1906 Shaarai Torah Synagogue, three-deckers and the city's 2015 revitalization initiative, with sources.
- [Living in Burncoat, Worcester, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/worcester/burncoat/): Burncoat, Worcester: the old Lancaster Way, the 1748 Amos Flagg House, stone walls of 1900-1910, the 1889 Burncoat Park and WRTA Route 14 on Burncoat Street.
- [Living in Back Bay, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/back-bay/): Back Bay, Boston: brownstone rows on land filled from 1857 to 1882, the Commonwealth Avenue Mall, Copley Square, and rail at Back Bay station. Sourced guide.
- [Living in Beacon Hill, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/beacon-hill/): Beacon Hill, Boston: Federal and Greek Revival row houses behind the 1798 State House, Louisburg Square, Charles Street, and the Red Line at Charles/MGH.
- [Living in South End, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/south-end/): South End, Boston: Victorian brick and brownstone rows from 1850 to 1880 around Union Park and other squares, the Southwest Corridor Park and the Orange Line.
- [Living in North End, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/north-end/): Boston's North End: brick apartment buildings on narrow streets around the Paul Revere House and Old North Church, between the Greenway and the harbor.
- [Living in Charlestown, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/charlestown/): Charlestown, Boston: founded 1629, red-brick rows on Breed's Hill, the Bunker Hill Monument and Navy Yard, Orange Line and ferry. 2025 Warren Group prices.
- [Living in East Boston, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/east-boston/): East Boston: former harbor islands laid out on a grid from 1833, with Jeffries Point and Eagle Hill, five Blue Line stops, Piers Park and 2025 Warren Group prices.
- [Living in Jamaica Plain, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/jamaica-plain/): Jamaica Plain, Boston: triple-deckers and Victorian houses between Jamaica Pond and Franklin Park, with four Orange Line stops and the Needham Line.
- [Living in Roslindale, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/roslindale/): Roslindale, Boston: one- and two-family houses around Roslindale Square, the Needham Line at Roslindale Village, and the Arnold Arboretum's Peters Hill.
- [Living in West Roxbury, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/west-roxbury/): West Roxbury, Boston: mostly single-family homes along Centre Street, three Needham Line stations, Millennium Park and Bellevue Hill, the city's highest point.
- [Living in Hyde Park, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/hyde-park/): Hyde Park, Boston: a former town with Cleary Square, Victorian Fairmount Hill and Readville, three commuter rail lines and the Stony Brook Reservation.
- [Living in Roxbury, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/roxbury/): Roxbury, Boston: Fort Hill's Greek Revival houses, row houses and triple-deckers around Nubian Square, with the Silver Line, the Orange Line and Franklin Park.
- [Living in Mattapan, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/mattapan/): Mattapan, Boston: triple-deckers and two-family houses around Mattapan Square, with the Mattapan Line trolley, two Fairmount Line stops and the Neponset trail.
- [Living in Dorchester, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/dorchester/): Dorchester, Boston: three-deckers and Victorian houses around Fields Corner, Savin Hill, Codman Square and Lower Mills, on the Red Line and Fairmount Line.
- [Living in South Boston, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/south-boston/): South Boston: row houses and triple-deckers from Dorchester Heights to Castle Island, with Red Line stops at Broadway and Andrew and three miles of shoreline parks.
- [Living in Allston, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/allston/): Allston, Boston: brick apartments, triple-deckers and Victorian houses on the Charles, by Harvard Stadium, with the Green Line B branch and the I-90 project.
- [Living in Brighton, Boston, MA | The Oberdorfer Team](https://oberdorferteam.com/communities/boston/brighton/): Brighton, Boston: triple-deckers, Aberdeen's Shingle-style houses and brick apartments by Chestnut Hill Reservoir, with the Green Line and Boston Landing station.
